question: Ivermectin is indicated in all of the following except:
analysis: Ivermectin is a medication primarily used to treat many types of parasite infestations. It is effective against Ascaris (a type of roundworm), filariasis (caused by infection with filarial worms), and onchocerciasis (river blindness, caused by the worm Onchocerca volvulus). However, ivermectin is not indicated for the treatment of malaria, which is caused by Plasmodium parasites transmitted through the bites of infected mosquitoes.
